senses.gloss:
[उद्धत-ष्यञ्] 
__1 Arrogance, insolence. 
__2 Boldness, bold or adventurous deeds; औद्धत्यमायोजितकामसूत्रम् [[Māl. 1. 4.]]

a. (-की f.) [उद्धार-ठञ्] Deducted from patrimony, portionable, heritable. 
-कम् 
__1 A portion or inheritance (deducted from patrimony). 
__2 A part to be set aside; [[Ms. 9. 150.]]
